prompt: Create an original 60 second acoustic jazz instrumental composition for celebration, positive conclusion and project reveal. Mood: hopeful, joyful, uplifting. Instruments: piano, upright bass, brushed drums. Style: relaxed swing, walking bass and conversational piano. Tempo approximately 108 BPM; C major. Main idea: a compact three-note motif. Introduce a memorable rising motif, develop it, and end with a confident resolved cadence. Instrumental only. No vocals, no choir, no humming, no singing, no speech, no lyrics, no vocal samples. Do not imitate any existing artist or melody. [00:00-00:20] Establish the main idea immediately with the core ensemble. [00:20-00:40] Develop the motif with a complementary instrumental counterline, preserving the intended energy. [00:40-01:00] Return to the main idea and give a musically resolved ending with a short natural tail. Finish around 01:00.

description.en: A lively and upbeat jazz track featuring a prominent piano melody, a walking upright bassline, light and swinging drums, and subtle electric guitar comping. The mood is sophisticated and positive.
description.zh: 一首活泼欢快的爵士乐曲，以突出的钢琴旋律、行进的低音提琴线、轻快摇摆的鼓点和微妙的电吉他伴奏为特色。氛围精致而积极。
